findings.title: Security header does not satisfy the reviewed value policy: content-security-policy
findings.summary: The final document response failed 2 semantic requirement(s): required CSP directives are missing: base-uri, form-action, frame-ancestors; forbidden CSP source tokens are present: 'unsafe-eval'. The raw header value was not retained.
reproductionSteps: Open the page in a fresh context.
Evaluate bounded semantic facts from the content-security-policy header without retaining its raw value.

remediation.summary: Configure a reviewed CSP: add the required directives base-uri, form-action, frame-ancestors; remove the forbidden source tokens 'unsafe-eval'. Validate application behavior in staging instead of copying a permissive placeholder.
technicalHints: Do not weaken the configured rule or add a permissive placeholder only to clear the gate.
